lines.text: I taught students most of my life, boy. A quick one takes a season to learn what you offer him. This town learned a new way of building and a new way of counting in the time it takes a crop to come up.
So does every student. That's what a teacher is. Here's what I can't put down: a student learns because a teacher chose to teach. Who chose us? And what do they mean to make of the class?
